notes.title: Last Patch
notes.notes: All of the armors are now up to date with names and descriptions. We are also working on our new game, 'Golden Castle'. Also we have a discord if you wish to join us there.

notes.title: Update for Bug Fixes and More...
notes.notes:
So there are a lot of bug fixes in this update.

Also you will notice that more equipment, items, spells, and skills have names and descriptions.

Also there is now some lore in the towns and even in some of the shrines (not all of the shrines). Also more items in the towns to get from houses.

Level cap has been changed to 30. Bosses are hard coded to now have a minimum level and maximum level.

notes.title: Upcoming Update
notes.notes:
Hi everyone,

I'm working on fixing quite a number of bugs/issues with the game so the next update won't be out until 9/15. This is so I have time to make sure that everything is working that I am working on. This is also ahead of the sale that is happening on the 16th that the game will be participating in. I want to make this game more enjoyable for all of you so please just be patient with me a while longer while I work on fixing these bug/issues with the game as I am just one person. 

Also even after this update comes out, please continue to report any issues/bugs you find with the game so that I can fix them in a timely manner or at least try my best to.

notes.title: Cyna Bug Update
notes.notes:
You can now leave the Dwarven area and continue on with the game. Sorry for taking so long with the update.

Working on fixing other things in the background as well and hoping to have other fixes/updates out before the 9/16/24.

Working next on armor names, and descriptions followed by spell/skill descriptions.

notes.title: Release Date - Pushed Back
notes.notes:
Sad day it is when the release date of a game has to be pushed back. 

I know that some of you were waiting on the release of this title as I do watch to see the number of people wishlisting the game rise. Sadly, we are currently a one-person company so when real life happens to get in the way sometimes the release date happens to get pushed back. I know that right now it just says Q2 for the release date but we/I am hard at work on the game. I'm not going to rush it though, because I still want to deliver a game worth playing. I just hope you can be patient with us a bit longer as we work on this.
